name: Williden Marshal
summary: Williden Marshal is the ambitious human leader of Marshal's Expedition, based out of Marshal's Refuge in northern Un'Goro Crater. Driven by the lure of rare flora, mysterious crystals, and profitable scientific research, he brought his team into the crater only to watch their lower camps overrun by the basin's colossal beasts.

sections.title: A Precarious Foothold
sections.body: Williden Marshal brought an entire scientific expedition deep into Un'Goro Crater seeking fortune and discovery. Intrigued by accounts of alien crystals, uncataloged plants, and untapped resources, he established multiple forward camps across the valley floor. However, the primeval wilderness quickly turned against them. The savage beasts of the crater dismantled their research posts, forcing Williden and his survivors to retreat up into the northern cliffs to establish Marshal's Refuge.

sections.title: Salvaging the Dream
sections.body: Despite being driven to the crater's mountainous edge, Williden refuses to pack up and abandon his investment. From the relative safety of the refuge, he hires passing adventurers to delve back into the savage lowlands to recover lost food crates, expensive scientific instruments, and his personal expedition journal. Though often known simply as 'Wil' to close comrades like Spark Nilminer, he takes the venture seriously—insisting on recovering their work even as titanic predators stalk the valley beneath them.

sections.title: Family Ties
sections.body: Williden is not the only Marshal in the crater: Hol'anyee Marshal shares his name and works alongside him at Marshal's Refuge. Together they chose the untamed primeval crater of southern Kalimdor, and Williden remains entirely convinced that Un'Goro's crystal deposits and ancient mysteries hold the true fortune.

faq.answer: Williden Marshal is a human explorer and the commander of Marshal's Expedition. He led a team of researchers and adventurers into Un'Goro Crater to study its strange crystals and flora, seeking knowledge and profit.

faq.q: Why is the expedition holed up in a cave?
aliases: why is the refuge in a cave
what happened to the expedition camps
faq.answer: The expedition originally established multiple research bases down in the lowlands of Un'Goro. However, the expedition underestimated the savagery of Un'Goro, and the crater's colossal predators overran the sites, forcing the survivors to flee to the northern rock ledges of Marshal's Refuge.

faq.q: What is Williden asking adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Williden asks capable explorers to brave the dangerous crater basin to recover supplies from their ruined camps, including abandoned food stores, delicate research equipment, and his lost expedition journal.

faq.q: What brought Williden to Un'Goro Crater in the first place?
faq.answer: He came in search of the crater's unique resources: rare flora, mysterious colored power crystals, ancient geological secrets, and the significant financial profits that scientific discoveries would yield back home.
The only other Marshal known in the crater is Hol'anyee Marshal, who shares his name and works alongside him at Marshal's Refuge.

faq.q: Is Williden Marshal aligned with the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: Though human, Williden runs a neutral scientific expedition out of Marshal's Refuge. He willingly accepts assistance from both Alliance and Horde adventurers willing to recover his supplies and clear threats from the crater.

angles.text: Williden represents the far-reaching curiosity and mercantile ambition of humanity, having journeyed all the way from the Eastern Kingdoms to the untamed depths of southern Kalimdor.
Though operating neutrally out of necessity in the wild crater, Williden and his core team share strong cultural and trade ties to the Alliance heartlands.
Williden's expedition was drawn to Un'Goro in large part due to the crater's unique, prehistoric vegetation that grows nowhere else on Azeroth.
